text.en: Asha's lunch box had rice, dal, vegetables and a fruit. "A balanced meal," said her mother.

Food is any substance of plant or animal origin eaten to give nutritional support. The classes of nutrients are carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals and water. Vitamin D is called the sunshine vitamin because our skin makes it in sunlight.
Food hygiene means keeping food and surroundings clean so that it does not carry disease. Food preservation prevents spoilage so that food can be used later, by drying, heating, cooling, adding natural preservatives or irradiation, which exposes food to rays that kill germs and pests.
Food adulteration is the mixing of cheap or harmful substances with food. Food quality control, with standards and tests, keeps food safe.

problem.en: Name two methods of food preservation.

text.en: Irradiation kills germs; so these are two methods.

prompt.en: A friend says Adulterated food is always safe. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: Adulteration mixes in cheap or harmful substances.

points.en: A balanced diet has all nutrients.
